page: Google Cloud Platform z4m-highmem-16 is a storage-optimized virtual machine built on the x86_64 processor architecture. The configuration supplies 16 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 122 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.62 GB of RAM per vCPU. Graphics processing units are not included with this instance profile. A primary hardware attribute is the bundled storage layer, which provisions a direct-attached 15,032 GB NVMe solid-state drive directly to the virtual machine.

From an infrastructure and resource efficiency perspective, the z4m-highmem-16 integrates an exceptionally large local NVMe storage volume relative to its core count. Delivering over 15 TB of direct-attached flash storage alongside 16 dedicated cores reduces external network storage latency and offloads hypervisor overhead. As local NVMe drives are ephemeral and complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not provided, system designs must implement software-level data replication and private networking to ensure high availability.

Due to the dense memory profile and substantial local NVMe capacity, the instance is aligned with I/O-intensive applications. Typical deployment scenarios include distributed NoSQL databases, search indexing nodes, big data caching layers, and real-time analytical engines requiring rapid read and write access to massive working datasets.
description: Google Cloud Platform z4m-highmem-16 is a storage-optimized virtual machine delivering 16 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and 122 GB of memory, complemented by a large 15,032 GB local NVMe SSD. The instance provides 7.62 GB of RAM per core without GPU acceleration or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. By combining substantial memory capacity with over 15 TB of direct-attached high-speed NVMe storage, this profile avoids the latency penalties associated with network-attached block storage. The local drive structure requires application-tier resilience to safeguard against node replacement events. With balanced compute capacity, robust memory allocation, and massive solid-state storage density, the z4m-highmem-16 is built for distributed datastores, Elasticsearch clusters, transactional logging systems, and real-time analytical workloads.
